name: bandit.extortion_reopened_fight_continuation_mcw
description: Real continuation from the committed McWilliams local-contact export: visibly choose Fight at the reopened shakedown, then use only ordinary gameplay turns to reach an authoritative terminal, save and exit, relaunch the same world with a new focused process, and read exact/stale terminal receipt replays without changing the winner.

steps.label: post_load_fight_continuation_settle
steps.expected_visible_fact: the untouched committed-contact export is loaded to a real gameplay HUD before any feature input

steps.label: preflight_current_committed_shakedown_reservation
steps.abort_reason: the copied save did not contain the current committed shakedown reservation that production requires before ordinary turns can open Pay/Fight
steps.expected_immediate_state: the untouched save contains one current local shakedown reservation with a toll job, player target, committed-contact phase, and at least two members before ordinary turns begin

steps.label: advance_299_turns_to_reopened_fight_gate
steps.expected_visible_fact: ordinary turns reach the reopened local-contact dialogue boundary

steps.label: advance_final_turn_to_reopened_fight_dialogue
steps.abort_reason: the real reopened local-contact dialogue did not visibly present Pay/Fight before selection

steps.label: audit_reopened_fight_surface
steps.abort_reason: same-run production log did not prove the visible reopened Pay/Fight surface

steps.label: choose_reopened_fight
steps.abort_reason: Fight was not visibly selected from the real Pay/Fight dialogue

steps.label: audit_fight_branch_started
steps.abort_reason: the production fight branch did not record its authoritative demand transition

steps.label: ordinary_combat_to_authoritative_terminal
steps.expected_visible_fact: only ordinary gameplay turns advance the visible combat until a responder casualty or survivor-return terminal is reached

steps.label: audit_authoritative_fight_terminal
steps.abort_reason: ordinary combat did not produce an authoritative casualty or survivor-return terminal

steps.label: audit_player_save_mtime_before_fight_reload
steps.expected_visible_fact: the pre-save player-save marker is captured before the full save/reload

steps.label: open_full_save_prompt_after_fight_terminal
steps.abort_reason: the full case-sensitive save-and-quit prompt was not visible

steps.label: confirm_full_fight_terminal_save
steps.expected_visible_fact: the fight terminal state is fully written before process exit

steps.label: audit_player_save_mtime_after_fight_save
steps.abort_reason: the full save did not advance the player-save marker

steps.label: audit_one_identity_stable_fight_receipt
steps.abort_reason: the same-run receipt did not expose operation, generation, epoch, member, and application identities

steps.label: advance_one_turn_after_saved_terminal_relaunch
steps.expected_visible_fact: the canonical startup owner focused a new process on the saved McWilliams world before the read-only replay observer runs

steps.label: audit_post_relaunch_terminal_replay_inertness
steps.abort_reason: the new-process log delta did not prove the released winner receipt stayed exact/stale readable, byte-stable, and uncredited

evidence_contract.claim: the committed-contact export reaches the real reopened Pay/Fight surface, Fight is visibly selected, ordinary combat reaches an authoritative responder casualty or survivor-return terminal, one matching receipt exposes its identity tuple, and a full save exits before canonical same-world relaunch proves exact/stale replay inertness
evidence_contract.fixture_binding: live-debug:bandit_extortion_reopen_local_contact_mcw_v0_2026-04-24 with manifest save_transforms=[]; no raw fixture or authored combat state is allowed
evidence_contract.preconditions_and_interventions: the only pre-feature setup is harness profile installation and copying the committed export; after the real gameplay HUD and focus gates, the scenario sends visible Fight and ordinary turn inputs only
evidence_contract.terminal: the run stops at the first missing authoritative terminal, save/exit, new-PID focus, or post-relaunch replay-inertness checkpoint and reports direct evidence
evidence_contract.identity_requirement: the receipt must expose one operation, generation, epoch, member, and application identity tuple before terminal save
evidence_contract.replay_status: the post-relaunch audit reads only the new-process debug-log delta; it requires an absent active operation, exact duplicate and stale replay dispositions, byte-stable serialization, and no outcome credit.  It cannot recreate an operation or rewrite the saved world.
